items.source: Called by afterPropertiesSet() on startup. The returned collection may be empty but must not be null.
items.translation: 由启动时调用的afterPropertiesSet()方法执行。返回的集合可能为空，但绝不能为null。

items.source: Triggered on startup through afterPropertiesSet(); can also be called to re-initialize at runtime.
items.translation: 在启动时通过afterPropertiesSet()触发；也可在运行时调用以重新初始化。

items.source: Check for a registered cache of the given name. In contrast to getCache(String), this method does not trigger the lazy creation of missing caches via getMissingCache(String).
items.translation: 检查给定名称的已注册缓存。与getCache(String)相反，此方法不会通过getMissingCache(String)触发缺失缓存的懒加载创建。

items.source: Abstract base class implementing the common CacheManager methods. Useful for 'static' environments where the backing caches do not change.
items.translation: 实现通用CacheManager方法的抽象基类。适用于后端缓存不会变化的“静态”环境。

items.source: Decorate the given Cache object if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，则装饰给定的 Cache 对象。

items.source: Get a collection of the cache names known by this manager.
items.translation: 获取此管理器已知的缓存名称集合。

items.source: name - the cache identifier (must not be null)
items.translation: name - 缓存标识符（不能为 null）

items.source: the associated Cache instance, or null if none found
items.translation: 关联的 Cache 实例，如果未找到则返回null

items.source: cache - the Cache object to be added to this CacheManager
items.translation: cache - 要添加到此 CacheManager 的 Cache 对象

items.source:
the decorated Cache object to be used instead,
or simply the passed-in Cache object by default
items.translation: 使用装饰后的 Cache 对象，或者默认情况下直接使用传入的 Cache 对象。

items.source: Caches may be lazily created at runtime if the native provider supports it. If a lookup by name does not yield any result, an AbstractCacheManager subclass gets a chance to register such a cache at runtime. The returned cache will be automatically added to this cache manager.
items.translation: 如果原生提供者支持，缓存可能会在运行时懒式创建。如果按名称查找未返回任何结果，AbstractCacheManager 的子类将有机会在运行时注册此类缓存。返回的缓存将被自动添加到该缓存管理器中。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
Note that the cache may be lazily created at runtime if the
native provider supports it.
items.translation: 请注意，如果原生提供者支持，缓存可能会在运行时懒加载创建。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.translation: 获取与给定名称关联的缓存。

items.translation: 初始化缓存的静态配置。

items.translation: 加载此缓存管理器的初始缓存。
